properties.notes: CH/13/0323 is outline planning permission for residential development: Erection of 111 dwellings, public house/restaurant and provision of public open space (outline all matters reserved), granted March 2016. CH/16/124 is reserved matters approval, granted June 2016. Incorporates 50% affordable housing provision (to be developed by Walsall Housing Group). The site included within the register excludes the area which has been reserved for commercial development under the original outline planning permission. Net developable area 3.1ha. 96 completions to date.
